conclusion: The actual candidate retains the complete closed core-wrap floor and opaque material. Relative to all seven frozen terrace meshes, only the exact 20 redundant core_base triangles are omitted. Complete core plan and z-volume containment is proved with exact arithmetic.

method.arithmetic: Exact rational arithmetic on literal JSON decimals and serialized IEEE-754 float32 values. Exhaustive triangulation/intersection, not sampling.
method.glb_axes: model x=glTF x; model y=-glTF z; model z=glTF y. Verified root nodes with no transforms or parents.

layout_plan_proof.method: Exact rational ear clipping, pairwise convex triangle clipping against closed half-planes, exhaustive area equality per source triangle; no sampling and no numeric tolerance.

actual_candidate_surface_coverage_proof.method: Exact rational ear clipping, pairwise convex triangle clipping against closed half-planes, exhaustive area equality per source triangle; no sampling and no numeric tolerance.

retained_floor_material.scope: Serialized glTF material is opaque; application-specific runtime material replacement is outside this verifier.

terrace_mesh_delta.scope: All seven terrace meshes are compared in the final assembled candidate. Original building/base meshes are outside this geometry-delta assertion.

float32_quantization.scope: Measured source-decimal to actual serialized GLB displacement for all vertices of the reference core-base slab and the current candidate core-wrap/east-plaza slabs. Not a whole-assembly clearance or gap test.

components.label: core_base
components.measured_geometry: frozen reference core_base, intentionally absent in candidate

float32_quantization.numeric_bound_caveat: A coordinate quantization bound measures representation displacement only. It is not a bound on arbitrary assembly gaps, offsets, overlaps, missing interfaces, or runtime transforms.

seams.basis: Identical rational endpoint coordinates and z intervals; entire straight segment and side rectangle coincide, not a sample-point estimate.
Identical rational endpoint coordinates and z intervals; entire straight segment and side rectangle coincide, not a sample-point estimate.

checked_retained_floor_seams.scope: Only the two entire shared boundary segments between east_plaza_4F_floor and core_wrap_4F_floor, with matching top, bottom and complete side rectangles. No claim that every interface in the building is gap-free.

limits: Model geometry only; not as-built survey or structural adequacy.
Global assembly manifoldness, arbitrary component interfaces and existing-base preservation are not established by this floor proof.
The final floor material differs from the neutral prototype intentionally; it remains opaque.
The exact frozen triangle set proves redundant base removal; triangle soup is not a global Boolean-solid union.
